Definition
[Finite-difference scheme (36.6--36.8)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0333, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0334 1. ch36:36.6,ch36:36.7,ch36:36.8\group Numerical Simulation

With $\Delta \psi =\pi /(N-2)$ and $F_i=F((i-\tfrac 32)\Delta \psi ,t_0)$, use \[ F'\approx \frac{F_{i+1}-F_{i-1}}{2\Delta \psi },\qquad F''\approx \frac{F_{i+1}+F_{i-1}-2F_i}{(\Delta \psi )^2},\qquad F_i^{n+1}=F_i^n+\Delta t\, G_i^n. \] The ghost-zone conditions are $X_1=X_2$, $X_N=X_{N-1}$ and the analogous equalities for $S$.
